headline.text: L2 ML2 was down *95 minutes* on folding disk belt and blade work — cleared by 12:13, running clean since

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran S2 and S3 with minor interruptions. S2 ultrasonic jammed the cutter at 04:51, cleared by 06:04. S1 cooling tunnel belt replacement in progress; enrober communication fault unresolved at window close. S4 received cold tapioca totes at 06:27, delaying startup.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 ML2 lost 95 minutes to folding disk belt and blade shimming; back up at 12:13. FFS X-ray fault at 15:52 cleared by 16:12. ML3 sensor faults at 19:39 and 20:30 each resolved inside 20 minutes. Big Joe #7 leaking hydraulic oil again, parked.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML4 ran clean after belt adjustments cleared at 13:04. ML1 managed chocolate deposition issues with pump speed tweaks throughout shift. Truffle line paused at 11:47 for CILT and guillotine belt; weight and oil ratio still being dialed in at window close. MF Matrix lot code mix at 23:16 addressed before 1st shift.

notes.text: S2 printer warnings (Cavannas, Matrix 6/7/8) flagged at end of shift — improper shutdown alerts.
S3 target depositor clumps from unsorted nuts during shift change caused downtime for 1st shift.
Hershey's Peco delivery delayed to 11:00; used 18 pallets of CandyCo Peco as bridge.
MF Matrix operator direction gap noted — lot codes mixed in hopper due to lack of handoff clarity.

resolved.title: S2 ultrasonic sensor jam at cutter
resolved.summary: Ultrasonic stopped working, caused major jam at cutter; line paused, maintenance reset in cabinet.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:04 — "Maintenance reset the ultrasonic in the cabinet and it started working again" (Joseph Scott).

resolved.title: S2 tunnel 3 belt threads
resolved.summary: Belt threads on tunnel 3 flagged as needing immediate attention; maintenance cut threads and reported to QA.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:24 — "We have cut all the threads—regards from the Belt—and it has been reported to QA" (Victor Romero Sr.).

resolved.title: FFS X-ray detector not rejecting test samples
resolved.summary: X-ray machine failed to reject test cards; maintenance troubleshot and cleared fault, verified 10 test passes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:12 — "The X-ray detector issue was resolved by Maintenance. Test cards were passed through the detector 10 times" (Wilson Amaris Cabrera).

resolved.title: ML2 folding disk belt failure and blade shimming
resolved.summary: Folding disk stopped spinning, flow-wrap bunching; maintenance replaced belt, shimmed blades, replaced broken roll pin.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:13 — "Line is running. No doubles or folds" (Jeffrey Barney). Total downtime ~95 minutes.

resolved.title: FFS gusset seal and bag quality
resolved.summary: Flow-wrap bunching at folding disks; maintenance cleaned blades, adjusted cut mark and gusset seal.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 19:09 — "The bottom part of the pouch is coming out well; both corners are sealed" (Marlenis Fernandez).

resolved.title: ML3 sensor PG303 loose, line faulted
resolved.summary: Sensor PG303 came loose, caused PG304 to shut off and line to fault; maintenance tightened sensor, cleared fault.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 19:53 — "Line start running" after sensor tightened and fault reset (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: ML3 sensor PG300 loose wire, second fault
resolved.summary: Sensors went out again 24 minutes after first fix; loose wire on PG300 found, tightened, system power-cycled.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 20:49 — "Line is running" after wire tightened and reset (Mathew Draper).

resolved.title: ML3 chicane support arms loose
resolved.summary: Second chicane support arms loose, dragging on belt below; maintenance tightened.

resolved.title: FFS roll spindle deflated and tracked off
resolved.summary: Roll spindle deflated, roll tracked off; maintenance re-threaded and restarted.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:12 — "Line is back up" (Jeffrey Barney).

resolved.title: MF Matrix lot code mixed in hopper
resolved.summary: Previous and new lot codes mixed in hopper during shift change; team separated product, emptied matrix.
resolved.resolution: Addressed before 1st shift — date change verified at 04:42, visual inspection confirmed scales and chutes clear (Jordan Serna).

resolved.title: Truffle Cavanna 2 arm blocking exit
resolved.summary: Cavanna 2 pusher arm moving excessively, blocking chocolate exit; maintenance adjusted and tightened.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:20 — "Maintenance has adjusted the arm, and it is now working properly" (TruffleLine FW).

resolved.title: ML4 belt adjustments before gondola
resolved.summary: Intermittent stops for technician to adjust conveyor belt before gondola; line ran clean once work completed.

needs_attention.title: S1 cooling tunnel belt replacement in progress
needs_attention.summary: Initial belt repair on cooling tunnel 1 failed; C&E replacing entire belt, waiting for belt delivery from SV2.
needs_attention.status: Belt replacement in progress as of 20:19; awaiting part delivery from SV2.

needs_attention.title: S1 enrober communication fault
needs_attention.summary: Enrober stopped communicating with other systems after power cycle; Jakob contacted, issue unresolved at window close.
needs_attention.status: Programmer messaged at 16:12; enrober still showing communication errors at window close.

needs_attention.title: S4 cold tapioca totes delaying startup
needs_attention.summary: Both tapioca totes cold when filling mixing tank; warehouse reported all remaining totes also cold.
needs_attention.status: Warehouse confirmed all tapioca totes cold at 06:50; no warming solution documented.

needs_attention.title: S2 printer improper shutdown warnings
needs_attention.summary: Both Cavanna printers and Matrix 6/7/8 showing improper shutdown warnings at end of shift.
needs_attention.status: Warnings flagged at 12:43 and 12:56; no resolution documented.

needs_attention.title: Big Joe #7 leaking hydraulic oil
needs_attention.summary: Forklift Big Joe #7 leaking hydraulic oil again; parked by heating cabinet, HOJ scheduled for tomorrow.
needs_attention.status: Parked and out of service; HOJ visit scheduled for next day.

needs_attention.title: Truffle guillotine belt slipping and product weight low
needs_attention.summary: Guillotine belt slipping, product coming out runny and underweight; line paused at 11:47 for CILT and belt work, adjusting oil ratio.
needs_attention.status: CILT in progress at 12:07; capture test at 12:13 showed 23.0% oil (target 22.6–22.8%); adjustments ongoing at window close.
